decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The application would have due regard for the external historic integrity of the listed building to the benefit of the visual amenity and would comply with the aims of policies Env-B.2.5 and Env-B.2.7.
Condition : 2 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 3 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 4 - The works hereby approved shall not be commenced until drawings of an appropriate scale (eg 1:20) showing details of replacement windows, including joinery details and the relationship of the frames to the openings have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The works shall then be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
description: Erection of single storey side and rear conservatory and erection of side extension incorporating internal alterations to house.
